How It Works

Simple steps to quality care

Step 01
📍
Enter Your Location
Share your area to see matching HCAs within your preferred radius - no travel hassle.
Step 02
🔍
Filter & Shortlist
Filter by care type, gender, language, shifts and period. Shortlist your top choices.
Step 03
📋
Create Account
Register as a client, add patient details and accept T&Cs to proceed to placement.
Step 04
✅
Placement & Care
Our team calls, visits and confirms the match. Pay and your HCA is placed - care begins.

Safety & Quality

Every assistant is verified

🪪
Identity Verified
National ID and biometric verification for every registered assistant before activation.
🎓
Credentials Checked
We verify education certificates, nursing qualifications and care certifications directly with issuers.
🔍
Background Screened
Criminal background checks and reference verification before any client-facing placement.
🛡️
Ongoing Quality Monitoring
Shift Cardex data, timeliness, client ratings and care compliance are tracked and reviewed continuously.
